## No config needed for anything on this side

---

# Workflow does this:

### Gens 4 4k quadrants --> performs seam fix

### Math already handled

# Edit just these two things:

### 1. D:\Comfy\ComfyUI_windows_portable\ComfyUI\output\8k
to your actual comfy path (keep the "8k" designation for folder)

### 2. C:\Users\alienuser\Documents\Dev\seemingly-epic\target\release\seamingly-epic.exe
to your actual path after running 
```
git clone https://github.com/CommanderTurtle/seemingly-epic
cd seemingly epic
cargo build --release
```
for the Rust project

### 3. That's literally it!
run
```
winget install --source winget --id Google.Libwebp
```
for optional extra webp optimizations
